items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1960-11-03
items.q: That was with Celestan up there.

ctx.x: This is my brother. I hate to leave him. And I know he hate to leave me. I know that. Yes, I bet. I know that. So God help me. I know that. I know that stuff No, there's no date on that picture. That was with Celestan up there. I don't believe we have any other questions to ask you. I suppose you want to get some rest, so we'd better turn it off. We certainly enjoyed talking to you and hearing about the old times that you were telling us. I've got some other books without a picture on it. Without pictures? I'd…
Did you go out on trips quite often? Oh yes.
